title: More ways to make things
summary:
Six community apps joined the catalog, from remixable image prompts to web translation, while the README caught up with May 29’s updates.

The app catalog added RagmyAI for image generation, SceneWeave for writing from pasted story text, and PetalGen for turning image prompts into structured, remixable modules.

The Mork Stack brings Discord-based workflows for social media and Solana trading; GrowthKit Studio uses Pollinations as its LLM backend to generate Business Kit reports.

Ai Web Translator, a Firefox extension for AI web translation with bring-your-own-key support, was added to the learn app catalog. These six additions bring the App Greenhouse count to 791.
